import asyncio

async def act(page):
    # Ensure the page is loaded
    await page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
    
    # Fill the searchbox with the article title
    searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search")
    await searchbox.fill("Treating your agents like microservices")
    
    # Press Enter to submit the search and wait for navigation
    async with page.expect_navigation():
        await searchbox.press("Enter")
    
    # Wait for the new page to load
    await page.wait_for_load_state('domcontentloaded')
    await asyncio.sleep(2)  # Additional wait for content to render
    
    # Check if the article title is present in the page content
    content = await page.content()
    if "Treating your agents like microservices" in content:
        # If found, get the URL of the current page
        url = page.url
        return url
    else:
        return "Article not found in search results."
